title: Input and constant gate construction
statement: For a natural number $n$, define a gate from either an input index $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ or a Boolean value $b$. An input index gives an AND gate whose sole argument is the natural-number value of $i$, while $b$ gives the constant gate with value $b$.
hypotheses_covered: An input index in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ or a Boolean value
